purpose: Declarative implementation contracts; handlers must be implemented and tested. This file is not an executable extraction engine.

rules.name: No production LLM calls
rules.handler_contract: Exclude generative models, LLM SDK calls, agents, embeddings and paid/cloud AI OCR from production processing; no hidden fallback.

rules.name: Offline processing boundary
rules.handler_contract: Deny network egress from processing workers; disable remote content in document viewers; bundle OCR assets locally.

rules.name: Reproducible decisions
rules.handler_contract: Pin engine, OCR model, parser, dictionary, rule and template versions; use stable ordering and an explicit as-of date.

rules.name: Measured diagnostics
rules.handler_contract: Display observed network attempts and enforcement state; never use a hard-coded zero counter as evidence of zero AI calls.

rules.name: Package identity
rules.handler_contract: Match basename ID candidates to IDs parsed from file content; folder suffix n in the samples is not part of the ID.

rules.name: Required and missing files
rules.handler_contract: PDF is required to extract; absent support files remain visible and their dependent cross-checks are NOT_RUN, not PASS.

rules.name: Ambiguous association
rules.handler_contract: Do not choose between different same-role files, versions or content IDs; allow explicit assignment with audit.

rules.name: Original preservation
rules.handler_contract: Keep original bytes, SHA-256 and package-relative path immutable; edits are new derived revisions.

rules.name: Archive and parser boundaries
rules.handler_contract: Reject traversal, unsafe links and configured expansion limits; disable XML external entities and network DTD/schema resolution.

rules.name: Sample isolation
rules.handler_contract: Expected output XMLs are development fixtures; never extract production fields from them, Redcarplus files or a prior final XML.

rules.name: Native layout extraction
rules.handler_contract: Store page dimensions, rotation, text direction, blocks, lines, spans, glyph/word boxes, font/style, links and annotations.

rules.name: Local OCR fallback
rules.handler_contract: OCR only regions with missing or unusable native text; record why, OCR boxes, recognition scores and model/version.

rules.name: Coordinate contract
rules.handler_contract: Use zero-based internal page indexes plus one-based display page numbers, points and top-left origin; store crop/rotation transforms.

rules.name: Layout reading order
rules.handler_contract: Segment columns and spanning blocks before sorting; never sort every word on a page only by y then x.

rules.name: Boilerplate separation
rules.handler_contract: Classify running heads, page numbers, captions and rotated arXiv stamps separately while keeping their evidence.

rules.name: Normalized text is secondary
rules.handler_contract: Produce searchable MD/text with token-to-source mappings; raw text, coordinates and original PDF remain available.

rules.name: Glyph and line repair
rules.handler_contract: Join soft wraps and reconstruct accent glyphs only with source layout evidence; preserve real hyphens, punctuation and raw text.

rules.name: Mathematics and symbols
rules.handler_contract: Preserve symbol relationships in rich text; unsupported radicals/scripts or damaged symbols require review, not API substitution.

rules.name: PDF identifier and version
rules.handler_contract: Read ID and positive integer version from the first-page arXiv stamp, including rotation; a basename is not version evidence.

rules.name: Scrapping verification
rules.handler_contract: Compare PDF ID with /ARXIV/item/@id and PDF version with normalized /ARXIV/version/@number such as [v2].

rules.name: HTML verification
rules.handler_contract: Compare citation_arxiv_id and the current version explicitly identified by the page; do not assume the largest history entry is the viewed version.

rules.name: Unexpected stamp location
rules.handler_contract: Search additional regions if the expected stamp is absent; retain any candidate and emit HOLD for unusual or missing location.

rules.name: ID construction
rules.handler_contract: Store base ID and integer version separately; serialize their validated combination as ARXIV itemid text.

rules.name: Conflicting version candidates
rules.handler_contract: Retain all source ID/version candidates. If the PDF stamp is absent, accept support identity only when normalized PDF and HTML titles match exactly, HTML and Scrapping base IDs agree, and every version present agrees. If any check fails, leave unsupported fields unset and create an informational note; a missing version is not v1.

rules.name: Title verification
rules.handler_contract: Compare normalized PDF title with HTML citation_title; ignore case and presentation markup, not different words or mathematical content.

rules.name: Conservative normalization
rules.handler_contract: Collapse layout whitespace and use approved typographic equivalences only; dash-to-double-hyphen equivalence is a named configurable rule.

rules.name: Title boundaries
rules.handler_contract: Join multi-line title regions, excluding running heads, date, authors and journal banners; preserve rich text and evidence.

rules.name: PDF-only abstract
rules.handler_contract: Extract abstract text only from PDF; API or HTML abstracts can be displayed but cannot populate or repair the output abstract.

rules.name: Abstract boundaries
rules.handler_contract: Use heading and layout evidence; support an unheaded abstract and cross-page continuation without including keywords or body sections.

rules.name: Abstract fidelity
rules.handler_contract: Check word boundaries, formulas and span coverage; a sample with glued words or raw API LaTeX is not an approved normalization rule.

rules.name: PDF keyword extraction
rules.handler_contract: Recognize PDF Keywords/Key words labels with a following period, colon, dash or em dash. Keep keyword text separate from the abstract and remove the label punctuation from the first keyword.

rules.name: Keyword boundaries
rules.handler_contract: Split on source-specific separators with layout evidence; retain punctuation and internal hyphens such as Four-roll-mill flow.

rules.name: Global PDF order
rules.handler_contract: Build one canonical author list in PDF reading order; count distinct canonical authors before creating affiliation groups.

rules.name: API identity verification
rules.handler_contract: Compare canonical PDF identities with ordered API authors; allow consistent initial/full-name expansions but not arbitrary fuzzy substitutions.

rules.name: Sequence verification
rules.handler_contract: Compare API author order to PDF global order; never reorder the PDF list to hide disagreement.

rules.name: Given and family names
rules.handler_contract: For matched identities use API forenames and keyname; keep original displayed PDF name and matching evidence.

rules.name: Initial generation
rules.handler_contract: Create initials deterministically, preserving existing initials, hyphens and diacritics; do not expand unknown names.

rules.name: Surname particles
rules.handler_contract: Preserve API surname components and multi-family surnames; configured particles are not a license to move words without evidence.

rules.name: Unspecified name policy
rules.handler_contract: If unstructured/non-Latin parsing needs a missing project rule, retain the displayed name for review rather than assume a universal last-token surname.

rules.name: One identity, repeated occurrences
rules.handler_contract: Reuse global_seq and the same canonical name/ORCID/email on all author-group occurrences; repeated seq across groups is legitimate.

rules.name: PDF-only affiliations
rules.handler_contract: Extract normal affiliations only from PDF; API or HTML organizations cannot fill missing fields.

rules.name: Marker mapping
rules.handler_contract: Map affiliation labels printed before or after an author name. A numeric label followed by comma or period starts the affiliation line. Do not treat the next author’s prefix as the preceding author’s suffix; preserve source evidence for each edge.

rules.name: Missing marker ambiguity
rules.handler_contract: Multiple possible affiliations with no reliable relationship require review; a single clearly shared affiliation may be linked by documented layout evidence.

rules.name: Original versus present address
rules.handler_contract: Prefer original/main affiliations; use current, former or work-completed-at information only when the author has no original affiliation.

rules.name: More complete original evidence
rules.handler_contract: Prefer demonstrably more complete versions of the same original affiliation; incompatible organizations/addresses are a conflict, not a merge.

rules.name: No correspondence backfill
rules.handler_contract: Do not manufacture a normal affiliation by copying extra address details from correspondence-only data.

rules.name: Organization decomposition
rules.handler_contract: Store all source-supported organizations in PDF order, including acronym-bearing named groups, and address components separately. Parse street/location lines (including Chemin) as address-part, distinguish UK postcodes from cities, and retain exact source wording in source_text.

rules.name: No geographic invention
rules.handler_contract: Do not infer city or country from institution reputation or web lookup; missing geographic parts remain missing.

rules.name: State dictionary
rules.handler_contract: Use state for USA, Canada and Australia under country-specific mappings; NSW and ACT are valid observed values and must not be truncated to two letters.

rules.name: Other administrative divisions
rules.handler_contract: Use address-part for other source-supplied subdivisions unless an explicit rule says otherwise; Kerala remains address-part.

rules.name: Country code mapping
rules.handler_contract: Use approved alpha-3 dictionary entries for explicitly supplied country/territory wording; preserve original wording in source_text.

rules.name: UK constituent wording
rules.handler_contract: Map explicitly supplied Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland to GBR while preserving the wording; do not rewrite source text.

rules.name: Territory mappings
rules.handler_contract: Map Hong Kong to HKG, Macau to MAC, and Taiwan or Republic of China to TWN under the project dictionary.

rules.name: Unspecified country cases
rules.handler_contract: Crimea or Palestine/Israel-related addresses without a stated country must not acquire an invented country.

rules.name: Department composition
rules.handler_contract: Combine shared institution and author-specific department fragments only through explicit PDF relationships; retain component-level provenance.

rules.name: Group serialization
rules.handler_contract: Order groups by source affiliation order and authors within each group by global_seq; repeat authors for multiple affiliations without renumbering.

rules.name: Unusual affiliation location
rules.handler_contract: Keep candidates found outside normal front matter/linked notes, show their location, and request review without blocking XML preview.

rules.name: Affiliation-free authors
rules.handler_contract: Retain authors with no known affiliation in an affiliation-free group; distinguish truly absent data from unresolved edges and never omit the author.

rules.name: PDF-only email
rules.handler_contract: Store at most one selected email per canonical author; preserve all candidates internally and flag unresolved multiple choices.

rules.name: Shared email notation
rules.handler_contract: Expand grouped local parts only when the complete common domain and author relationship are explicit on the same PDF.

rules.name: Email completion limits
rules.handler_contract: Fill incomplete email components only from unambiguous PDF evidence; no guessing from names or external lookup.

rules.name: PDF ORCID evidence
rules.handler_contract: Accept visible number or PDF hyperlink attached to the relevant author/logo; a logo with no recoverable link is not an identifier.

rules.name: ORCID format
rules.handler_contract: Normalize the identifier only; validate configured syntax/check-digit rules and identity association; store at author/@orcid, not an invented ce:orcid element.

rules.name: Single-author decision
rules.handler_contract: For one canonical author, email or affiliation is sufficient for correspondence; explicit correspondence is sufficient; neither means no unless explicit text says yes.

rules.name: Multiple-author evidence
rules.handler_contract: Require explicit correspondence text or an author-attached correspondence marker with a resolved meaning.

rules.name: Non-correspondence marker
rules.handler_contract: Equal contribution, present address and other identified non-correspondence markers do not set correspondence.

rules.name: Email-only or affiliation-only symbol
rules.handler_contract: An asterisk on email/affiliation without a matching author indicator does not set correspondence.

rules.name: Unexplained symbol
rules.handler_contract: An unresolved star/envelope/dagger is evidence to review, not automatic correspondence.

rules.name: Correspondence serialization
rules.handler_contract: Create a separate head/correspondence per selected person, with person, optional evidenced affiliation and selected ce:e-address in the observed order.

rules.name: Article applicability
rules.handler_contract: Apply the 1970-to-as-of-year scope to the article, not to each cited work; retain older citations such as the 1967 reference in 2408.09700.

rules.name: Section discovery
rules.handler_contract: Discover all main/supplementary bibliography regions using headings plus layout and bibliographic entry patterns.

rules.name: Heading-free bibliography
rules.handler_contract: A missing heading must not yield zero references; retain the detected list and flag missing/unusual section identification.

rules.name: Column/page continuation
rules.handler_contract: Continue an entry across column or page breaks until the next confirmed boundary; never truncate at a page/column limit.

rules.name: Numbered boundaries
rules.handler_contract: Detect source labels only at entry starts in a confirmed reference region; body citations, years and figure labels are not entry starts.

rules.name: Unnumbered boundaries
rules.handler_contract: Use hanging indentation, recurring author/year starts and block structure; URLs, DOI lines and indented continuations stay with their entry.

rules.name: Source-label removal
rules.handler_contract: Strip only the detected leading source label from exported reference text; retain original_label and its bounding box internally.

rules.name: No citation enrichment
rules.handler_contract: Capture incomplete references as found; do not fetch DOI metadata, search the web or use support abstracts to complete them.

rules.name: Shorthand-only entries
rules.handler_contract: An entry consisting only of ibid, supra, op. cit. or loc. cit. is an explicit excluded candidate with a reason, not a fabricated work.

rules.name: Non-Roman-only entries
rules.handler_contract: Exclude entirely non-Roman references with a logged reason; mixed-script or unclear cases require review, not automatic deletion.

rules.name: Main versus footnote references
rules.handler_contract: When normal references exist capture those, excluding footnote citations; if only bibliographic footnotes exist capture them with HOLD.

rules.name: Inline citations
rules.handler_contract: Do not turn body-only inline citations into bibliography entries; retain exclusion classification for coverage review.

rules.name: Multiple works in one entry
rules.handler_contract: Split only on a supported multi-work boundary with source spans; semicolons alone are insufficient evidence.

rules.name: Supplement and multiple regions
rules.handler_contract: Inventory main and supplemental reference regions in document order; multiple distinct locations trigger review and explicit inclusion decisions.

rules.name: Underscore placeholders
rules.handler_contract: Flag blank/underscore author placeholders; keep source text and do not copy an earlier author name into the reference.

rules.name: Output ordering
rules.handler_contract: Use source region order, source entry order and split-part order, then assign contiguous output seq starting at 1.

rules.name: DOM-derived refcount
rules.handler_contract: Set bibliography/@refcount from the actual serialized reference elements; validate again after any direct XML edit.

rules.name: Independent source coverage
rules.handler_contract: Independently inventory labels/start lines and region coverage; reconcile accepted, excluded and pending candidates instead of trusting output count alone.

rules.name: Duplicate handling
rules.handler_contract: Flag identical/similar candidates with evidence; never silently deduplicate separate source entries.

rules.name: No extraction caps
rules.handler_contract: Do not impose hidden limits on pages, references, text length or first-N extraction; configured resource limits stop visibly and preserve partial work.

rules.name: Coverage accounting
rules.handler_contract: Require C=A+X+U and R=sum of emitted parts for accepted candidates; extra split parts are recorded and excluded/pending counts are visible.

rules.name: No fixed target counts
rules.handler_contract: 58, 89, 45 and 82 are regression expectations, never production extraction constants or values copied from expected XML.

rules.name: Namespace profile
rules.handler_contract: Use default ANI http://www.elsevier.com/xml/ani/ani and ce http://www.elsevier.com/xml/ani/common; XML lang uses the XML namespace.

rules.name: DOM-only serialization
rules.handler_contract: Build qualified elements/attributes using an XML builder, escape text once, serialize UTF-8 and parse the result; no raw concatenation or injected fragments.

rules.name: Exact observed hierarchy
rules.handler_contract: Use units/unit/unit-content/bibrecord with sibling item-info, head, tail, and bibliography under tail; preserve observed child order.

rules.name: Static versus dynamic fields
rules.handler_contract: Pin constants in a profile, derive article data from current evidence, and obtain timestamp from an explicit frozen run context.

rules.name: Placeholder delivery values
rules.handler_contract: unknown, none and ??? are sample literals, not verified client delivery values; require profile selection or recorded acceptance, while allowing draft/forced export.

rules.name: Observed reference shape
rules.handler_contract: Default sample profile uses ref-info empty, ref-fulltext and ce:source-text; do not invent structured reference children without an approved extension.

rules.name: Optional and missing values
rules.handler_contract: Omit unsupported optional values rather than invent them; missing required values produce a partial full-document draft plus explicit issues, never fabricated text.

rules.name: Mixed content
rules.handler_contract: Treat inline text, tails and script spans as rich content; sup/inf are in the inherited ANI namespace; do not turn radicals into superscripts.

rules.name: No unapproved output metadata
rules.handler_contract: Store audit, confidence, HOLD reasons and evidence outside client XML; do not inject telemetry, internal IDs, EGI/IPUI or DOI elements absent from the selected profile.

rules.name: Schema status
rules.handler_contract: Without a supplied client XSD report XSD NOT_RUN, not schema-valid; local sample-profile checks are a separately named validation layer.

rules.name: Technical failure versus HOLD
rules.handler_contract: Malformed XML remains editable/saveable as a draft; a HOLD override does not turn a parser/schema error into a validation pass.

rules.name: Full preview on HOLD
rules.handler_contract: Generate the full document preview from all available data after extraction even when HOLDs remain; show absent/affected fields beside the XML.

rules.name: Metadata editing
rules.handler_contract: Allow every specified field, author-affiliation edge and reference to be edited; retain extracted and accepted values as separate revisions.

rules.name: Full XML editing
rules.handler_contract: Offer the entire XML document with undo, search/replace, validation, line/column navigation, save and download; do not limit users to forms.

rules.name: Direct edit protection
rules.handler_contract: Mark direct XML edits and retain their revision; later metadata changes make XML stale, never silently replace manual edits.

rules.name: Regenerate or keep manual XML
rules.handler_contract: Provide explicit regenerate-with-confirmation and keep-manual actions; snapshot the current XML before replacement.

rules.name: Override controls
rules.handler_contract: Allow edit, evidence view, accept extracted value, override and keep HOLD; record rule, issue, user, old/new values, timestamp and optional reason.

rules.name: Selective reevaluation
rules.handler_contract: Re-run affected rules after edits; an override applies to a specific evidence/value/rule revision and becomes stale when those inputs change.

rules.name: Traceability after raw edits
rules.handler_contract: Map recognizable XML nodes back to canonical fields; unmatched manual nodes are explicitly unmapped, not falsely linked to PDF evidence.

rules.name: Validation layers
rules.handler_contract: Report parser, sample-profile, business, source-verification and optional XSD results separately; missing checks are NOT_RUN.

rules.name: Unique author checks
rules.handler_contract: Validate distinct global author identities, contiguous global sequence and correct group edges; do not compare API count with raw XML author occurrence count.

rules.name: Final artifact validation
rules.handler_contract: Validate the selected current XML revision immediately before export; do not reuse results from a previous generated revision.

rules.name: Error navigation
rules.handler_contract: Use parser line/column against the exact buffer revision; formatting invalidates old coordinates; map to metadata/evidence when available.

rules.name: Normal export
rules.handler_contract: Normal export requires passed technical gates and resolved/validly overridden review issues under the chosen delivery profile.

rules.name: Export with HOLDs
rules.handler_contract: Permit deliberate export with unresolved HOLDs, show the list, record acknowledgement and export status; never relabel it VERIFIED.

rules.name: Technical-error draft download
rules.handler_contract: Allow saving/downloading an invalid edit buffer as an explicitly invalid draft; do not present it as a validated delivery XML.

rules.name: Revision and audit export
rules.handler_contract: Record selected XML hash, revision, input hashes, profile/rule versions, validation snapshot and unresolved/overridden issue IDs in sidecar audit JSON/CSV.

rules.name: Independent jobs
rules.handler_contract: Support 1, 5 and 25 packages; a failed article does not stop other articles, and completed work survives restart.

rules.name: Multidimensional status
rules.handler_contract: Keep processing, review, XML, validation and export states separate; XML_GENERATED and ON_HOLD may coexist.

rules.name: Rule update governance
rules.handler_contract: Version rule/dictionary changes, validate their schema, run regression fixtures and record activation; manual correction never trains an unpredictable model.

rules.name: Quarantined conflicts
rules.handler_contract: Do not bless contradictory sample fields as golden truth; maintain observed and approved expectations separately with issue IDs.

rules.name: No unsupported success claim
rules.handler_contract: Distinguish specification checks, XML parse checks, PDF inspections and actual application tests; do not infer full client acceptance or accuracy from sample counts.

effective_runtime_policy.note: The per-rule on_failure severities describe the design catalogue; the current local workflow has no HOLD state and applies this nonblocking runtime override.
